intermediate.name: 1st passage of the finish line
intermediate.title: Sprint | 1st passage of the finish line (132.5 km)

story: At the start, four riders broke away but were caught on the final climb thanks to Soudal Quick-Step’s effort. Sjoerd Bax and Axel Van Der Tuuk attacked on the descent but were caught just 300 meters from the finish. Molano won the sprint ahead of Magnier and Teutenberg.
